title: Allergen Labels (per language)
description: Shape of every data/translations/allergens/<tag>.json file: an object keyed by the allergen `key` from data/allergens.json, so a lookup is O(1) with no join step. A locale that does not carry the legal `declaration` sentence omits the field rather than guess it; the generated bundle then falls back to English and records the field in `fallbacks`.

declaration.description: The legal group declaration sentence, identical for every member of a group, e.g. 'Enthält Getreide und glutenhaltige Erzeugnisse'. Render once per group, not once per member.
